visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and small bruises on his face is interviewed outdoors during the day. He wears a white and green sports jacket with the Kappa logo. Behind him is a school running track and a multi-story building. He looks upward and smiles as he speaks, occasionally gesturing with his hands. (2) The scene shifts slightly as the young man touches his neck and looks thoughtfully into the distance. The lighting is bright natural daylight. He continues talking while a microphone with a yellow 'HahaTai' tag is held near him by an unseen person. (3) The setting changes to a dimly lit outdoor environment at night. The man remains in the same white sports jacket. He appears emotional but hopeful, rubbing his nose and mouth with his hand while looking directly at the interviewer. Warm artificial light illuminates his face against a dark background.
